create_Checkpoint: create a Checkpoint instance to manage training checkpoints with automatic resume from existing files
store_metric_Checkpoint: store training metrics with timestamps using the Checkpoint store_metric method with keyword arguments
store_state_Checkpoint: store model state dicts and track best states using the Checkpoint store_state method
save_Checkpoint: save checkpoint data to disk with and without model states using the Checkpoint save method
clean_state_dict: clean a state dict by removing module. prefixes from DistributedDataParallel wrapped model keys
